items.name: Southwest of F.A.N.G Center
items.location: House by a small body of water southwest of F.A.N.G Center
items.guide: Eliminate enemies outside to the left of the house. Enter the house; the card is on a shelf above the couch.

items.name: North West of Cedar Lake
items.location: Lakeside house northwest of Cedar Lake
items.guide: Clear the enemies on the lakeside of the building. Head inside to find the card on the chest of drawers next to the bed.

items.name: West of Cedar Lake
items.location: Mountain cabin west of Cedar Lake
items.guide: Access via grapple or flying vehicle. Clear enemies and enter through the front door; the card is immediately behind the opening door on a desk.

items.name: North of Whitetail Park Visitor Center
items.location: Shack in the hills north of Whitetail Park Visitor Center
items.guide: Enter the enemy-free shack and turn left. The card sits on a shelf.

items.name: South West of Clagett Boathouse
items.location: Petrol station on the road southwest of Clagett Boathouse
items.guide: Enter the petrol station building. The card is on a shelf underneath the 'Clothing' sign.

items.name: Cooper Cabin
items.location: Cabin northeast of the Wolf's Den
items.guide: Head inside to the room with a mattress propped up against the wall. The card is on the shelf straight ahead.

items.name: F.A.N.G Center
items.location: F.A.N.G Center gift shop
items.guide: Liberate or clear the cultists. Enter the building to the right of the main entrance; the card is on a merchandise shelf in the center of the gift shop.

items.name: McNeil Residence
items.location: Northeast of F.A.N.G Center along the road
items.guide: Clear the cultists and enter the white shed to the left. The card is on a shelf on the wall behind the door.

items.name: North East of Baron Lumber Mill
items.location: White shipping-container style house on race tracks behind Baron Lumber Mill
items.guide: Clear nearby enemies, kick down the boarded-up door, and take the card off the wall as you enter.

comic_books.quest_giver_location: Dodd Residence (between Fall's End and Rae-Rae's Pumpkin Farm), Holland Valley

items.name: Parker Laboratories
items.location: West of Fall's End
items.guide: Go up the stairs inside the house with the green roof. The comic book is directly ahead on the desk.

items.name: Boyd Residence
items.location: Directly west of the Dodd Residence
items.guide: Enter the house, turn left into the bedroom, and find the comic book on the bed next to a hunting bow.

items.name: Bradbury Farm
items.location: South of Lamb of God Church, below crop circle
items.guide: Enter the large barn to the right. Jump up to the second level via boxes in front of the blue tarp; the comic is on an old mattress.

items.name: Jefferson Lookout Tower
items.location: Mountain peak west of the Wolf's Den
items.guide: Go to the cliffside entrance and ascend the stairs into the tower. The comic sits on a table right inside the entrance.

items.name: McNeil Residence
items.location: On the road between F.A.N.G Center and Fort Drubman
items.guide: Break the boarded-up window around the back of the house. Enter into the second room, turn left into the bathroom, and grab the comic from the basin.

items.name: Elliot Residence
items.location: South of F.A.N.G Center
items.guide: Climb onto the verandah where the barbed wire is broken and enter through the broken window. The comic is on cases next to a lamp.

items.name: Peaches Taxidermy
items.location: Peaches Taxidermy workshop grounds
items.guide: Enter the grey house through the white door on the left side of the property. The comic is located right next to the television.

items.name: Chan Residence
items.location: Just south of Angel's Peak
items.guide: Go around the back of the house, enter through the blue door, and find the comic on a bed directly behind the door.

items.name: Vasquez Residence
items.location: Waterfront between Faith's region and Dutch's Island
items.guide: Dispatch the cultists outside, enter through the front door, and grab the comic from the living room couch.

items.name: O'Hara's Haunted House
items.location: Border of Faith and John's regions, northwest of Dead Man's River
items.guide: Climb the crate with blue ropes behind the house onto the roof, drop to the scaffolding, and crouch through the second-floor window. The comic is on a mattress.

items.name: Boshaw Manor
items.location: Southwest of Moonflower Trailer Park
items.guide: Walk up the ramp into the house marked with 'No Smoking' signs. Go to the rear bedroom; the comic is on the bedside table.

items.name: Camp Cougars
items.location: Campsite southeast of Peaches Taxidermy
items.guide: Clear cultists/predators at the campsite. The comic is lying on the ground directly in front of one of the tents.

items.name: Baron Lumber Mill
items.location: Baron Lumber Mill main building
items.guide: Ascend the front stairs and enter through the window. The bobblehead is straight ahead in the kitchen.

items.name: Whitetail Park Ranger Station
items.location: Southwest of F.A.N.G Center
items.guide: Enter the main office, go behind the front desk into the adjacent room, and grab the bobblehead from the chest of drawers on the left wall.

items.name: Island North of Grand View Hotel
items.location: Small island cabin north of Grand View Hotel
items.guide: Swim north to the island log cabin. The bobblehead is located inside on a splash of blood on the bed.

items.name: Lansdowne Airstrip
items.location: Hangar north of F.A.N.G Center (Inside 'Hangar Pains' Prepper Stash)
items.guide: Grapple the nearby radio tower, wingsuit/parachute onto the hangar roof, drop through the open skylight, and find the bobblehead on a shelf.

items.name: Whitetail Park Visitor Center
items.location: Visitor Center gift shop
items.guide: Head up the stairs and turn left into the souvenir shop. The bobblehead sits directly in front on a merchandise display shelf.

items.name: South Park Entrance
items.location: Border of Jacob's and John's regions, north of Rae-Rae's Pumpkin Farm
items.guide: Ascend the wooden stairs behind the buildings. The bobblehead is on the floor mixed with discarded junk.

items.name: St. Isidore School
items.location: Abandoned school northeast of Fall's End
items.guide: Climb onto the main school roof to retrieve the keys from the chimney. Zipline to the outbuilding, unlock it, and pick the bobblehead up from the shelf.

items.name: Bradbury Tractor Shed
items.location: North of the crop circle between Fall's End and Lamb of God Church
items.guide: Approach the small building next to the shed, break the wooden slats covering the window, and retrieve the bobblehead inside the broken refrigerator.

items.name: 8-Bit Pizza Bar
items.location: West of Hope County Jail
items.guide: Walk through the front door, pass behind the service counter into the kitchen, and grab the bobblehead off the shelf next to the dishware.

items.name: Feeney Residence
items.location: Eastern outskirts of Henbane River
items.guide: Clear the cultists in the field and enter the house. The bobblehead is on the kitchen counter against the wall.

vietnam_lighters.quest_giver_location: Redler Residence, East of Fall's End

items.name: West of Cedar Lake

items.name: North West of Widow's Creek
items.location: Bunker off the main road northwest of Widow's Creek
items.guide: Enter the roadside bunker and retrieve the lighter located in the back room next to the television.

items.name: Whitetail Park Visitor Center
items.location: Visitor Center information building
items.guide: Climb the stairs and turn left into the information center. The lighter is on a set of shelves in the second room to the left.

items.name: Elliot Residence
items.location: Bunker at Elliot Residence (South of F.A.N.G Center)
items.guide: Enter the upper story via the broken window, navigate down to the kitchen for the keycard, shoot the bunker lock in the shed outside, and find the lighter on the bench.

items.name: Fillmore Residence
items.location: East of Fall's End, west of Dead Man's River
items.guide: Enter the antler-adorned shed and descend into the bunker. The lighter sits on shelves in the second room.

items.name: Miller Residence
items.location: Southwest of Fillmore Residence
items.guide: Head to the white shed and drop down into the bunker hatch. The lighter is on the floor beside the nightstand.

items.name: Harris Residence
items.location: Northwest Holland Valley
items.guide: Enter the bunker via the hatch inside the brown wooden shed. The lighter is on the shelves beside the bed.

items.name: Rae-Rae's Pumpkin Farm
items.location: North of Fall's End
items.guide: Find the bunker hatch out in the open behind the farm buildings. The lighter is on a chair beside the bed.

items.name: McCoy Cabin
items.location: West of Peaches Taxidermy
items.guide: Locate the bunker hatch partially covered by green tarp. The lighter is on the shelving unit in the second room.

items.name: McClean Residence
items.location: Border between Faith's region and Dutch's Island
items.guide: Clear any hostile cultists and access the bunker near the rear of the property. The lighter is on the bed in the rear room.

items.name: Abercrombie Residence
items.location: East of Hope County Jail
items.guide: Go behind the main house to find the bunker entrance before the stairs. The lighter is on shelves in the second room.

items.name: Counselor's Cabin
items.location: West and slightly south of Moonflower Trailer Park
items.guide: Walk between the house and shed to reach the backyard bunker hatch. The lighter is in the second room on the shelf near the couch.

items.name: Osprey Cabin
items.location: Directly south of Wolf's Den down the cliff
items.guide: Enter through the side door of the log cabin. The crate sits on the coffee table between the sofa and television.

items.name: Dansky Cabin
items.location: South of Wolf's Den between two roads
items.guide: Approach the front door with the keypad lock; the vinyl crate is located outside under a table to the left of the door.

items.name: Hunter's Pass Shelter
items.location: Northwest of Wolf's Den
items.guide: Clear the area around the small brick cabin and head inside. The crate is on a table immediately past the door.

items.name: Red Tail Cabin
items.location: Directly east of Wolf's Den
items.guide: Enter the large wooden house and turn left into the kitchen. The crate rests on the counter beside the window.

items.name: Breakthrough Camp
items.location: East of Red Tail Cabin
items.guide: Pass through the main camp gate and turn right to the first lock house. The crate is on a shelf along the entryway wall.

items.name: North Park Entrance
items.location: Road heading west from F.A.N.G Center
items.guide: Go inside the southern building. The vinyl crate is sitting on top of a low bookshelf.

items.name: The Grill Steak
items.location: Outdoor restaurant south of F.A.N.G Center
items.guide: Walk past the barbecue grill and truck toward the gazebo shelter. The crate is in front of a tent underneath.

items.name: MCA Mobile Lab
items.location: East of Baron Lumber Mill
items.guide: Dispatch any wolves roaming the perimeter. The crate is sitting directly under the open grey canopy tent.

items.name: Linero Building Supplies
items.location: North of Baron Lumber Mill, west of Fort Drubman
items.guide: Proceed to the construction trailer at the back of the site, enter the blue door, and retrieve the crate on a desk behind a filing cabinet.

items.name: South Park Entrance
items.location: Border road between Wolf's Den and Rae-Rae's Pumpkin Farm
items.guide: Enter the roadside office next to the ACROD parking spot. The crate is on the floor in front of tipped filing cabinets.

whiskey_barrels.quest_giver_location: Can of Worms Fishing Store, Silver Lake, Henbane River

items.name: Can of Worms North
items.location: Under the docks north of Can of Worms
items.guide: Dive under the wooden dock just north of the store. The barrel is underwater near the dock posts.

items.name: Silver Lake Central Island
items.location: Sunken boat south of the central island in Silver Lake
items.guide: Locate the sunken rowboat sitting off the south shore of the island. The barrel is inside the wreckage underwater.

items.name: Dutch's Island Inlet
items.location: Waterway just east of Dutch's Island shore
items.guide: Dive near the submerged metal cage and rocks off the shoreline to find the barrel.

items.name: Joseph's Island West
items.location: Submerged river bed west of Joseph's Compound island
items.guide: Swim down where the riverbed drops off steeply; the barrel sits next to a cluster of lake reeds.

items.name: Joseph's Island South
items.location: South shoreline of Joseph's island in Silver Lake
items.guide: Dive beneath the floating wooden debris logs off the southern point of the island.

items.name: Train Bridge East
items.location: Under the railroad bridge crossing Silver Lake
items.guide: Swim underwater near the eastern concrete support pillar of the train bridge to locate the barrel on the lake floor.

items.name: Train Bridge West
items.location: Western section beneath the railroad bridge
items.guide: Dive near the sunken rail wagon resting on the underwater rocks.

items.name: Tanami Residence Inlet
items.location: Lake inlet southwest of the Tanami Residence
items.guide: Dive near the small submerged rowboat tied to a sunken anchor line.

items.name: Drubman Marina South
items.location: Waterway south of Drubman Marina
items.guide: Locate the floating red buoy and dive directly down underneath it to retrieve the barrel.

items.name: Drubman Marina Bay
items.location: Open bay water southeast of Drubman Marina
items.guide: Dive to the sandy floor near the submerged rock formation.

items.name: Clagett Boathouse Inlet
items.location: Under the docks at Clagett Boathouse
items.guide: Swim underneath the westernmost dock slip to find the barrel resting against the wooden piling.

items.name: Grand View Hotel Basin
items.location: Lake floor southeast of Grand View Hotel
items.guide: Swim south from the hotel deck toward the island; the barrel is underwater next to a cluster of rocks.

items.name: Moccasin River Crossing
items.location: River bottom south of the Moccasin River rail trestle
items.guide: Dive down beneath the bridge where the current slows; the barrel sits between two boulders.

items.name: Dead Man's River Mouth
items.location: Where Dead Man's River flows into Silver Lake
items.guide: Dive near the river mouth where water deepens; the barrel rests beside a sunken tree trunk.

items.name: Dutch's Island Channel
items.location: Channel between Holland Valley north shore and Dutch's Island
items.guide: Swim to the midway point in the channel and dive down near the half-submerged pickup truck cab.
